name: Chemical and Biological Engineering PhD
summary: Chemical and Biological Engineering doctorate with project and adviser selection during the first semester.
detailsNote: Current central field page explicitly confirms Fall 2027 deadline and $90 fee. Department How to Apply retains older $75 fee and a different 250-word prompt; current central requirements take precedence, with departmental additional prompt confirmed before submission. Detailed English page timed out; opened central admissions policy establishes exemptions.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application
deadlines.note: Central field page explicitly identifies Fall 2027.

applicationFee.note: Central hardship, listed past/present affiliation, designated recruiting event code or virtual-workshop routes through Fee Waiver Request page after creating account. Request at least two business days before department deadline; decision normally 2–3 business days. Do not pay/submit before decision; if denied pay by deadline. No citizenship restriction stated; international applicants must confirm eligibility. Department also lists need-based SEAS contact Julie Yun; older $75 fee superseded by central $90.

english.note: Opened central policy requires TOEFL/IELTS/DET for applicants whose primary language is not English unless undergraduate instruction entirely English certified by institution with degree awarded before enrollment, or at least two full-time academic years graduate study entirely English certified and completed by application opening. English-medium attendance alone without stated conditions is not a guaranteed exemption. Detailed current minimum/test-format rules not established because English page repeatedly timed out; confirm with Graduate School.

documents: Exactly three recommendations in English from people familiar with academic work
Transcripts from degree-granting institutions, with official English translations when needed; fall grades when applicable
Personal statement in English, maximum 250 words
Select up to five aligned faculty in application
requirements.note: A bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent is required. Department reviews holistically with no set minimum component criterion. Current central personal statement addresses a formative experience and contribution to the scholarly community; department additionally lists an older 250-word diversity/inclusion prompt, so confirm whether a separate response is required. First-semester project/adviser exploration includes optional temporary lab rotations, choices before winter break and joining a group in January. At least one teaching semester is generally required, subject to an approved fellowship exception.

funding.note: Department PhDs pay no tuition and receive stipend for standard five years while making good progress. Central natural-science/engineering support includes student health plan,10-month first-year fellowship, later RA/TA and coordinated external awards, summer research at RA monthly rate. No current amount or separately explicit international funding statement established.

timeline.interviews: Department lists program visit days February 18–20 and March 4–6, 2027; visit dates are not described as universal interview requirements.
